property_summary: For any call to fallback that sends exactly 10 ether and occurs at a strictly later timestamp than the contract's stored pastBlockTime, the correct contract only transfers away its entire balance when block.number % 15 == 0 (so address(c).balance == 0 iff block.number % 15 == 0); the mutant inverts the condition and will drain at block.number % 15 != 0, breaking that invariant for some block numbers.
change_summary: Change the conditional so transfer happens when block.number % 15 != 0, altering when balance is drained and thus state after call.
